intended_object: This is an auxiliary reparametrization used inside a proof. It packages the project-specific `relativeFactor T κ L (y, η)` as one function of the point ((κ, y), η), so that smoothness and jet bounds can be stated jointly in the parameter κ, including κ = 0. I inferred this from the docstring, from the section header "Actual parameter jets, uniformly including κ=0", and from how the library uses it in `relativeFamily_smooth` and the later jet bounds.
explanation: The body only reorders arguments: it treats the parameter κ as a coordinate of the point and passes everything on to the library's own `relativeFactor`. The docstring describes exactly that formula, so the definition matches its documentation. There is no standard object in the literature that it is meant to formalize. It is a technical device for the library's smoothness and jet estimates in its Navier–Stokes construction, and Mathlib has no counterpart.
